title: Generalization Under Distribution Shift
interviewAnswer: IID test performance can fail under covariate, label or concept shift. Use time/geography/group-aware validation, shift diagnostics and post-deployment monitoring when future data differs from training.
why: Distribution shift is one of the most common reasons production performance differs from offline evaluation.
intuition: A model trained on one year, hospital or country may see systematically different deployment inputs.
deepDive: Different shifts change p(x), p(y) or p(y|x). Some shifts can be reweighted; concept shift usually requires adaptation/retraining.
commonMistakes: Randomly splitting temporal data and claiming future generalization.
production: Design validation to mimic deployment and monitor performance by important slices.
workedExample: Fraud strategies evolve after a detector is deployed, changing p(y|x).
